description: Inspect Android keyboard visibility/type or press/dismiss the device keyboard. The dismiss action hides the keyboard. It taps the keyboard dismiss/hide key when one is exposed, verifies the keyboard closed, and reports UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION when the keyboard stays up — background taps are never attempted. On iOS a keyboard with no dismiss key adds error.details.reason keyboard_dismiss_unavailable with dispatched: no; one whose key was tapped and stayed visible has no reason and dispatched: unknown. Android reports keyboard_dismiss_unavailable with dispatched: unknown, since its own dismiss keyevents were already sent. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

name: keyboard
